description:
Experience powerful off-road performance with the STK 02 Electric Dirt Bike, designed for riders who seek adventure, speed, and control. Built with a 3000W Peak Brushless Motor and a high-capacity 60V 20.8Ah Lithium-ion Battery, the STK 02 delivers strong acceleration, reliable power, and an exciting riding experience across different terrains.

With a top speed of 37 MPH and a riding range of up to 28.3 miles, the STK 02 is ready for trail riding, outdoor exploration, camping adventures, and private land riding. The advanced hydraulic suspension system helps absorb bumps and improves comfort, while the dual disc brake system provides responsive stopping power and better control.

Featuring a durable frame, off-road tires, and rider-friendly design, the STK 02 combines performance, reliability, and fun in one electric dirt bike. Whether you're exploring dirt trails or enjoying outdoor adventures, the STK 02 is built to deliver confidence and excitement every ride.

Key Features

⚡ 3000W Peak Power
High-performance brushless motor delivers powerful acceleration and strong torque for off-road riding.

🚀 37 MPH Top Speed
Experience thrilling speed and responsive performance on trails and outdoor terrain.

🔋 60V 20.8Ah Lithium-ion Battery
High-capacity battery provides consistent power for longer riding adventures.

🏔 28.3 Miles Range
Ride farther with reliable battery performance designed for outdoor exploration.

🛠 Hydraulic Suspension System
Advanced suspension absorbs bumps and improves ride comfort and control.

🛑 Dual Disc Brake System
Responsive braking performance provides enhanced safety and confidence.

💪 Built for Off-Road Adventures
Durable frame and quality components are designed to handle various terrains.

👍 Easy to Ride
User-friendly design provides excellent control for different riding skill levels.

Why Riders Choose STK 02

🌱 Zero Emissions
Enjoy eco-friendly electric power with a cleaner riding experience.

🔧 Minimal Maintenance
Spend less time on maintenance and more time riding.

🛡 Built to Last
Strong construction and reliable components made for long-lasting performance.
